source_review.notes: Checked all six references against the official Google SRE site for title, authorship or edition, and nearby claim support. The first SRE book supports the trait-based definition of toil, separation from overhead and engineering work, and the source-specific 50% operational-work goal. The workbook supports local upper bounds, toil measurement, typed human-backed interfaces, self-service, incremental rollout, defensive automation, bounded impact, feedback, and total-effect review. The automation chapter supports consistency, speed, force-multiplier risk, and preferring designs that remove intervention. Release Engineering supports production-grade automation context. All six canonical URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-06.
